description.value: A tidy 20-site BC Parks campground beside a small sandy beach on Seeley Lake, backed by the Hazelton Mountains, 10 km west of Hazelton on Highway 16; good for a quiet overnight with swimming, trout fishing, canoeing (electric motors only), and a short marsh wildlife-viewing trail. Pit toilets only; highway access is paved and straightforward.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Seeley Lake Park is an active provincial campground with pit toilets, picnic tables, a sandy beach, and 20 campsites (from OSM capacity tag). The website explicitly states e-bikes are not allowed on trails and are restricted to park roads. No mention of potable water, showers, hiker/biker sites, or most other amenities; the OSM phone number (+1-250-842-6546) is listed under operator Emma Stephens and cannot be confirmed from the BC Parks website, which only lists general BC Parks contact numbers.
concerns: OSM lists operator as 'Emma Stephens' with email 'emma@bulkley.net' (a private/personal address), suggesting a contracted private operator rather than direct BC Parks staff; this is common for BC Parks but the personal contact details may not be stable long-term.
OSM phone number (+1-250-842-6546) appears to be the private operator's line; it is not confirmed on the BC Parks website, which lists only general BC Parks contact numbers.
No physical address recorded in OSM; only directional description available (10 km west of Hazelton on Highway 16).
Website notes e-bikes are not permitted on trails — relevant caution for e-bike touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate BC Provincial Park campground directly on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16), a primary touring-cyclist corridor in northern BC; suitable overnight stop with confirmed facilities.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity tag indicates 20 sites. Pit toilets confirmed (website mentions 'pit toilets are available'). Bicycles restricted to roadways; e-bikes restricted to park roads only per BC Parks policy.

wow_evidence: small sandy beach on Seeley Lake ... swimming, trout fishing, canoeing
